question: Does a new Mistral Free account still need a phone number, and does the same Organization still activate a Vibe CLI key, a Vibe app session and a Free mode API key?
why: the help centre phone section was gone by the archived copy of 2026-08-24 and no live first-party page states a phone step, but the registration form (email and password only) cannot show a step that follows sign-in. Third-party reports of 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-25 describe a Free-plan console that says 'Upgrade to activate your API keys' with the New key button disabled. Only an account shows what the Free plan gives. The coding-subs record states kind any-phone while the inference and compute records of the same account system state email
